top_signals.title: Old Mutual Profit Drops as US-Iran War Fallout Curbs Investments
top_signals.summary: Profit at Old Mutual declined for the first time since 2022 as risk-off sentiment from conflicts in the Middle East curbed investment returns at the Africa’s biggest insurer by assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
